description: Templar role builds for the Ascent Plan.

records.label: Shield tank
records.summary: The main tank. Hold the boss with Enmity, keep Warding up, block big hits for Fury's party buff, and fire Judgment after every shield skill.

coreSkills.name: Judgment
coreSkills.target: Mastery 11, then +4 from Daevanion nodes. The guide's skill level 20 needs more: Mastery stops at 11 and the build names no other source
coreSkills.why: Main damage hit: every shield skill makes it ready. First in 102 of 172 published priority lists.

targetProvenance.note: Mastery stops at skill Lv 11 (mechanics.json, mastery-cap). The guide target "Lv 20" is reworded against the cap: the build names this skill's Daevanion nodes, one +1 on each of the first four boards (progression.json, daevanion-boards). Gear and Arcana are not named as a source for this skill.

coreSkills.name: Vicious Strike
coreSkills.why: Your MP filler, held on left click: MP back on every hit. Its skill Lv 12 option cuts Warding Strike.

coreSkills.name: Punishment
coreSkills.target: Mastery 11, then +4 from Daevanion nodes. The guide's skill level 20 needs more: Mastery stops at 11 and the build names no other source
coreSkills.why: Charged hit that grants Executor: PvE damage +20% for 20 s.

coreSkills.name: Warding Strike
coreSkills.why: Self heal and damage tolerance buff. It also makes Judgment ready.

picks.pick: Ignores Block and Evasion and lands as a Critical Hit
picks.perk: Ignores Block and Evasion and lands as a Critical Hit

picks.pick: Up to 12% more damage when fewer targets are hit
picks.perk: Up to 12% more damage when fewer targets are hit

picks.pick: Party gains PvE Damage Tolerance on use
picks.perk: Party gains PvE Damage Tolerance on use

alternatives.name: Empyrean Lord's Punishment
alternatives.why: More damage: a heavy AoE hit that stuns. 67% of top players run it.

alternatives.name: Battlefield Banner
alternatives.why: More damage: Attack from Defense for 10 s. 65% of top players run it.

alternatives.name: Nezekan's Shield
alternatives.why: A party shield for a boss that needs one.

stigmas.note: Taunt, Shield of Protection, Doom Shield and Noble Armor: the tank set most published tank builds share. Swap Doom Shield for Empyrean Lord's Punishment where stagger matters.

priorities: Judgment +1 on every board you open
Vicious Strike, Warding Strike, Punishment and Pummel +1
Fury and Insulting Roar +1 on Zikel

rotation.note: These are priorities, not a fixed order. Keep defensive skills on your own keys.

rows.name: Judgment
rows.why: Fires whenever a shield skill has made it ready: Shield Smite, Warding Strike, Doom Shield or Shield Rush.

rows.name: Shield Smite
rows.why: Stuns NPCs, so Annihilate can fire, and makes Judgment ready.

rows.name: Warding Strike
rows.why: Heals you, grants Warding and makes Judgment ready. Your main attack cuts its cooldown.

mainAttack.name: Vicious Strike
mainAttack.why: Held with the macro key: instant, no cooldown, usable while moving, MP back.

rows.name: Debilitating Smash
rows.why: Fires first when ready. Most players start this stack with it.

rows.name: Annihilate
rows.why: Fires on a stunned or knocked-down target: Shield Smite in the shield stack opens it.

rows.name: Flash Rampage
rows.why: Fires only on a staggered target, so it never blocks the stack: it waits above Pummel.

rows.name: Pummel
rows.why: No cooldown, so it sits last: it fills every gap and raises your Enmity.

ownKeys.name: Noble Armor
ownKeys.why: Max HP up for 120 s: press it before the pull and keep it up.

ownKeys.name: Punishment
ownKeys.why: Charged: hold it to full charge for Executor. A macro only fires stage 1.

ownKeys.name: Taunt
ownKeys.why: Raises your Enmity and shrinks the boss: use it on the pull and after a res.

ownKeys.name: Poach
ownKeys.why: Pulls one target to you from 20 m: you choose which.

ownKeys.name: Shield of Protection
ownKeys.why: Hold it for a big boss hit: a sure Block, MP back, and Fury's party buff.

ownKeys.name: Defiance
ownKeys.why: Clears crowd control: you need it at a chosen moment.

ownKeys.name: Doom Shield
ownKeys.why: A 20 m dash: it knocks the target down and makes Judgment ready. Use it when you mean to move.

ownKeys.name: Shield Rush
ownKeys.why: Fires after a Dodge or in flight, and makes Judgment ready.

layoutProvenance.where: Skill bar and Macro window, Templar
layoutProvenance.note: The right-hand block holds stack A, the main attack, stack B. Macro 1 has two entries, stack A and stack B, 10 ms delay each.

ascent.why: Hold the boss with Enmity, stay alive, and keep Fury's party buff up with your blocks.

preferences.count: 49 of 287 builds put Doom Shield on top of the Judgment stack; 62 give it a key of its own
preferences.why: Some builds put Doom Shield at the top of the shield stack.

preferences.count: Taunt is in a stack in 99 of 287 builds and in 24 published macros
preferences.why: Some builds put Taunt in a stack or the macro.

preferences.count: Judgment comes first in 102 of 172 published priority lists
preferences.why: Judgment levelled first.

preferences.count: A levelling build copied 66 times: spam Pummel and the macro until Vicious Strike and Judgment are Lv 12
preferences.why: Pummel levelled first while you level.

preferences.count: 21 of 23 tank builds with four stigmas; 76% of 153 top players
preferences.why: Enmity, and Shrink for the whole party.

preferences.count: 17 of 23 tank builds with four stigmas; 37% of top players
preferences.why: Max HP up for 120 s; later Insulting Roar and Fury count 1.5 times.

preferences.count: 11 of 23 tank builds with four stigmas; 61% of top players
preferences.why: A sure Block that sets off Fury.

preferences.count: 11 of 23 tank builds with four stigmas; 61% of top players
preferences.why: Makes Judgment ready and knocks NPCs down.

preferences.count: 10 of 23 tank builds with four stigmas; 65% of top players
preferences.why: Attack from Defense for 10 s.

preferences.count: 7 of 23 tank builds with four stigmas; 67% of top players
preferences.why: A heavy AoE hit that stuns.

preferences.count: The editorial levelling build on one stats site slots Taunt at Lv 22
preferences.why: Taunt in the first slot.

preferences.count: 6 of 35 tank priority lists start with Warding Strike
preferences.why: Warding Strike levelled first.
